surfaces.name: Rovai Desktop (Electron app, macOS arm64/x64 and Windows x64)
Browser workspace (Desktop Web access or standalone Server)
Rovai Server (rovai-server host package for macOS, Linux and Windows)
Built-in rovai CLI for teammates (private IPC) and rovai-server commands

claims.answer: Electron Desktop (macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64), a browser workspace through Desktop Web (port 8766) or a standalone Rovai Server (macOS, Linux x64, Windows) usable from phone browsers, Feishu/Lark/DingTalk channels on Desktop, and a built-in rovai CLI for teammates. No native iOS/Android app, no Linux desktop app, no editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: Desktop packages for macOS Apple Silicon and Intel and Windows x64; no Linux desktop package in the release asset list.

mobile_apps.answer: No iOS or Android app in the release assets or guides; mobile access is a browser or a channel bot.

browser.answer: Browser workspace through Desktop Web or Server with token login.

mobile_browser.answer: Responsive browser UI with a phone-width login and conversation; guides note a phone capture is a responsive capture, not a physical device test.

cli.answer: `rovai-server` command (paths, token, run) and a built-in `rovai` CLI that teammates use through private IPC; no general user CLI to drive conversations.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension in the repository or guides.

task_actions.answer: Start, steer (mentions, interrupt on supported agents), approve, review files changed, stop and resume from Desktop and the browser.

notifications.answer: Desktop notifications for approvals, mentions, round completed, one-on-one replies and failed runs; Feishu/DingTalk deliver results to chat.

cross_device_continuity.answer: The workspace lives on its host; another browser continues the same conversation and runs, but separate instances do not sync.

claims.answer: Connects already installed coding Agents through native protocols and ACP: Codex CLI, Claude Code, Pi, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kiro, Qoder, CodeBuddy, Qwen Code, TRAE CLI CN, Kimi Code, Grok Build, DeepSeek Harness, MiniMax Code, Kilo, ZCode and Antigravity; Cursor, Cline and Command Code are not generally available. harnesses.answer: Seventeen documented agents with host entry points; platform availability varies per adapter; Cursor awaits qualification and Cline/Command Code are deferred.

model_providers.answer: Models come from each Agent's catalog; DeepSeek Harness can add providers and llm-pi-ai models; Rovai holds no provider accounts.

custom_adapters.answer: Contributors can add adapters (ACP transport, native adapters); no end-user custom adapter UI.

session_integration.answer: Rovai drives each runtime through its native protocol (App Server, stream JSON, JSONL RPC, ACP) rather than launching a terminal.

claims.answer: Documented path: install Desktop (or Server), install and sign in to one Agent, check Settings → Agents, create a teammate, open a project conversation and send a small task. claims.answer: Teammates use a built-in authenticated `rovai` CLI over private IPC; the Server has a browser/API surface for its own UI with token login; users have `rovai-server` management commands. claims.answer: Humans address teammates by structured mention; the Default Lead receives by default; deliveries wait in per-teammate FIFO queues with claims; Tasks record an owner; writers on the same file are the user's responsibility. Claim is enforced by the scheduler.

evidence.finding: Sparse source-qualified Token/Cache/Cost usage from runtime parsers and native readers, versioned public price catalog without network access, derived rows retained 45 days.

evidence.title: Desktop app updates
evidence.finding: Electron updater reads packaged release channel manifests; no analytics component.

evidence.title: Runtime run workspace validation
evidence.finding: AgentRun workspace access must be read_only or write and isolation must be shared or git_worktree.

evidence.title: Mission workspace
evidence.locator: owned_worktree_intact line 197, prepare_worktree_cleanup line 1123, remove_verified_worktree line 1231
evidence.finding: Mission workspaces prepare, verify and clean up managed Git worktrees.

evidence.title: Git observation
evidence.finding: Observes workspace Git state; no commit, push or PR operation outside tests.

evidence.title: ACP runtime adapter
evidence.finding: Shared ACP transport adapter used by OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro, Qoder, CodeBuddy, Qwen, TRAE, Kimi, Grok, DeepSeek Harness and others.

evidence.title: Agents and models
evidence.finding: Identity, Agent and model are separate choices; configuration changes apply to future runs; permissions and approval choices come from each Agent.

evidence.title: Agent setup and notes
evidence.finding: Supported agent list with host entry points (codex, claude, pi, mcode, dsh, opencode, kilo, copilot, kiro-cli, qodercli, codebuddy, qwen, traecli, kimi, grok, ZCode, Antigravity); credentials are reused from native installs; Pi/DSH/Grok version floors.

evidence.title: Platforms and Agents
evidence.finding: Desktop packages for macOS arm64/x64 and Windows x64; Server packages for macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64 and Linux x64 GNU; Linux agent support keeps a preview boundary.

evidence.title: Manage teammates
evidence.finding: Lasting teammate identities with role, responsibilities, principles and separate run configuration; roster versus conversation team.

evidence.title: Collaborate and hand off work
evidence.finding: Mentions are structured recipients; implementer and reviewer example; agent-to-agent handoff is a separate supported path; avoid two writers on one file.

evidence.title: Follow execution
evidence.finding: Run panel states (queued, running, waiting for approval/input, failed, completed), teammate cards, step details; three panel positions.

evidence.title: Use the mission board
evidence.finding: Mission links a goal to one team conversation and workspace; Git projects get a managed shared worktree from current local HEAD; cumulative changes; start is separate from business status.

evidence.title: Tasks and responsibility
evidence.finding: Tasks record owner, scope and status (Pending, In progress, Blocked, Complete, Cancelled); creating a task does not start an Agent; cancel does not stop a run.

evidence.title: Scheduled tasks
evidence.finding: Host-based recurring requests: each occurrence creates its own conversation; overlapping occurrences are skipped; approvals cancel unattended runs; missed runs do not replay; not a cloud service.

evidence.title: Review and manage memory
evidence.finding: Shared, teammate and between-teammate memory with scopes, retrieval keys, revisions and candidate review; agents may write their own teammate memory directly.

evidence.title: Use Skills
evidence.finding: Native Agent skills inventory, Rovai Toolbox collaboration instructions assignable to teammates, / picker for one request.

evidence.title: Connect MCP tools
evidence.finding: Settings → MCP adds or imports server JSON and assigns teammates; the Agent must support it; run panel proves use.

evidence.title: Review approvals
evidence.finding: Approval requests come from the Agent capability; native choices; pending area above the composer; decision applies to one request.

evidence.title: Stop, interrupt and resume
evidence.finding: Withdraw before claim, stop one run, cancel task, change mission status; stop is not undo; reopen conversation after app or agent interruption.

evidence.title: Preview files and changes
evidence.finding: File preview beside the conversation, per-run Files Changed cards and Mission cumulative changes; an unavailable diff is a missing view, not proof of no changes.

evidence.title: Usage and monitoring
evidence.finding: Settings → Agent usage by range, agent, provider, model; missing values stay unknown; cost grouping by call, turn, run or session; JSON export.

evidence.title: Notification settings
evidence.finding: Pending approval, mention, round completed, one-on-one reply, execution not completed, mission and task reminders.

evidence.title: Deployment and access overview
evidence.finding: Desktop Web (port 8766) or independent Server (8767); LAN HTTP, Tailscale or public HTTPS; no data migration or synchronization between instances.

evidence.title: Enable Desktop Web access
evidence.finding: Toggle in Settings → Remote connection; token login; listener accepts host network interfaces; QR login option; web service must be re-enabled after app restart.

evidence.title: Install and run Rovai Server
evidence.finding: Published native packages for macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 glibc 2.35+, Windows x64; installer script with SHA256SUMS; ordinary user account; default data directory ~/.rovai-server; Channels not provided.

evidence.title: Sign-in and maintenance
evidence.finding: Single-owner instance with a login token; no documented rotate-token command; browser disconnect does not stop accepted work; foreground operation.

evidence.title: Connect a channel
evidence.finding: Feishu, Lark and DingTalk bots deliver requests to the connected Desktop host; Server does not provide channels.

evidence.title: Your first task
evidence.finding: Prepare one Agent, choose a teammate, give a small task and inspect the run.

evidence.title: Download and install
evidence.finding: macOS DMG and Windows per-user EXE; signing identity changed at v0.4.1 needing one manual replace on macOS.

evidence.title: Withdraw and queue messages
evidence.finding: Withdraw before any recipient claims; queued runs wait behind current work; one-on-one has a FIFO.

evidence.title: Rovai AI v0.5.12 release
evidence.finding: Notes add conversation fork and Kilo agent; assets are Desktop dmg/zip for macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64 exe, and Server packages for Linux, macOS and Windows with install scripts and SHA256SUMS.

evidence.title: README image sources
evidence.finding: First-party provenance: workspace-team-ready.png is an unedited app screenshot from a 0.4.1 local acceptance build.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No telemetry or analytics code; the only match is a Pi telemetry environment variable that is filtered from member environments.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No pull request creation, rebase or merge operation in the pinned source; git.rs only observes state.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No multi-user roles, SSO or invitations; documentation states a single-owner instance.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No container or VM launcher for agent work; isolation values are shared or git_worktree only.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No inbound webhook or Git-event trigger; triggers are schedules and Feishu/Lark/DingTalk channel messages.

evidence.title: Bounded source search
evidence.finding: No managed-cloud execution; Server is user-run.

changes.summary: Initial full-profile source pass over pinned release v0.5.12 (commit 120af14): README, PRODUCT, SECURITY, rovai.dev user guides, architecture notes, agent-integration notes, release notes, Rust core and desktop source with bounded searches, covering all 51 criteria. Repository is a single monorepo (Rust host, Electron desktop, web UI, website); no closed component was found.

locations.result: v0.5.12 (2026-11-12) is the latest release; releases ship every two to three days with bilingual notes describing shipped changes only; Desktop and Server share the tag.
Adapter inventory dated 2026-10-10; Cline and Command Code deferred, Cursor Agent awaiting qualification; no dates promised.
Open feature requests (opt-out for Memory 1074, headless dispatch interface 1017, skill binding 1081, plugin support 1096) are user requests, not maintainer announcements.
User guides describe the current release; no pricing or roadmap page; guide notes call out preview platforms and unavailable settings.

gaps: No public roadmap page exists; open feature requests are not treated as announcements.
